An '''iron axe''' is an [[Tools#Axe|axe]] of the [[Iron equipment|iron]] tier, crafted from three [[iron ingot]]s and two sticks. It hits as hard as the [[copper axe]] ({{Hp|9}}) but swings slightly faster and lasts longer.

== Usage ==

=== Woodcutting ===
It breaks axe blocks at speed {{Value|Iron Axe|miningspeed}} and has {{Value|Iron Axe|durability}} durability. Matcha Flavoured adds beds, candles, cacti and honeycomb blocks to the blocks that axes break quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Iron Axe|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Iron Axe|attackspeed}}, against 0.8 for the copper axe.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into a single iron ingot, and at a [[smithing table]] it takes [[steel alloy]] to become its [[Steel equipment|steel]] counterpart. With a [[smithing upgrade template]] it becomes a [[steel dolabra]] instead.
